senses.gloss: निभ (I) a. (f. भा) (at the end of compound) Like, similar, resembling, खद्योतालीविलसितनिभां विद्युदुन्मेषदृष्टिम् Megh.ii.18.
निभ (II) m.n. 1. Appearance, light, manifestation; 2. pretence, disguise.

निभृत a. (f. ता) 1. Placed down, lowered; 2. concealed, secret, unperceived; 3. modest, humble, mild, gentle; 4. lonely, solitary; 5. still, silent; 6. firm, immovable; 7. on the point of setting, R.viii.15; 8. filled with, full of.(निभृतम् is used as an indeclinable in the sense of- (1) privately, secretly, imperceptibly; (2) silently.)
